# Getting help

- **How Vestigium works and what a report means:** the
  [wiki](https://github.com/Filipe-Soares-de-Almeida/Vestigium/wiki), starting with the
  [FAQ](https://github.com/Filipe-Soares-de-Almeida/Vestigium/wiki/FAQ) and
  [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/Filipe-Soares-de-Almeida/Vestigium/wiki/Troubleshooting), and the
  [README](https://github.com/Filipe-Soares-de-Almeida/Vestigium#readme).
- **A question, or an idea that is not ready to be a request:**
  [Discussions](https://github.com/Filipe-Soares-de-Almeida/Vestigium/discussions).
- **A freeze that Vestigium did not explain, or a report that looks wrong:** open a *Diagnosis help* issue
  from [New issue](https://github.com/Filipe-Soares-de-Almeida/Vestigium/issues/new/choose) and paste the
  report. In the app, open the freeze and select **Copy report**; the wiki explains
  [how to report a problem](https://github.com/Filipe-Soares-de-Almeida/Vestigium/wiki/Reporting-a-problem).
- **A bug or an accessibility barrier:** use the matching form in New issue.
- **A security problem:** report it privately, as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

Vestigium is free software maintained on a best-effort basis, so an answer can take a few days.
